data.narrative:
Ambrosia Energy is a Growth-stage private company in the Climate & Energy sector, founded by Ben Longmier and Sara Spangelo. The valuation universe consists of 1 public comparable (Lonza, ticker LNZA) and 8 private peers including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

Peer-median valuation analysis is not applicable here. Despite 8 same-sector private companies in the dataset, none met the minimum threshold of 3 datapoints when filtered by stage (Growth), adjacent stages, or valuation tier. A sector-wide median drawn from this fragmented set would introduce material noise, as the Climate & Energy sector spans heterogeneous business models, capital intensity, and revenue stages. The single public comparable provides limited triangulation power on its own, given structural differences between public market pricing and private Growth-stage risk profiles.

Without sufficient peer clustering, traditional multiple-based methods cannot reliably bracket a valuation range. Key uncertainties limiting this analysis include: the absence of disclosed fundraising history or current valuation, difficulty isolating stage-equivalent peers in an early-stage-dominated sector, and limited public market depth (n=1). A complete valuation would require either expanding the private peer set with better stage/subsector matching, or applying cash-flow or scenario-based methods if unit economics and financial projections were available. Current data is insufficient to support a defensible point estimate or range.
